options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Game Mode
options.doc:
Trophy Mode: To win, the player needs to collect one trophy apparatus from each moon (11 with no custom moons).

Collectathon: A new rare scrap is added, called the Archipelago Chest. To win, the player must collect a certain 
amount of them as well as a selection of random scrap

Credit Hunt: To win, the player needs to receive a specific amount of company credit items from the multiworld.

options.name: Collectathon Scrap Goal
options.doc: The number of collectathon scrap you need to complete the collectathon goal

options.name: Collectathon Random Scrap
options.doc:
Collectathon mode:
The number of random scrap required in addition to the main collectathon scrap
options.doc_fr:
Mode Collectathon :
Le nombre de débris aléatoires requis en plus de la ferraille principale

options.name: Credit Replacement
options.doc:
Credit Hunt mode:
Replaces the specified percent of filler items with company credits
options.doc_fr:
Mode de chasse au crédit :
Remplace le pourcentage spécifié d'éléments de remplissage par des crédits d'entreprise

options.name: Required Credits
options.doc:
Credit Hunt mode:
The percent of company credits in the pool that are required to beat the game. If there are 20 credits in the pool
and the player sets this to 75, then once 75% of the 20 credits, or 15 credits, are collected, they will win
options.doc_fr:
Mode de chasse au crédit :
Le pourcentage de crédits d'entreprise dans la piscine qui sont nécessaires pour battre le jeu. S'il y a 20 crédits dans la piscine et que le joueur met cela à 75, alors une fois 75% des 20 crédits, ou 15 crédits, sont recueillis, ils gagneront

options.name: Grade Locations Per Moon
options.doc:
The total number of grade locations generated for each moon. A grade location is completed by collecting enough 
scrap in one day to obtain the minimum required grade on a moon.

options.name: Num Quotas
options.doc:
The number of quota locations to create. A quota location is completed whenever the player fulfills
money_per_quota_location-worth of quota. Progress accumulates over quotas and crew wipes.

Ex: If money_per_quota_location = 70 and the first quota is 120, then 1 quota location will be completed when the 
    player fulfills their first quota. If the second quota is 200, then 3 additional quota locations will be 
    completed when the player fulfills their second quota. 320 total quota has been fulfilled at this point, so a
    total of 4 quota locations are complete.

options.name: Quota Checkpoint Every
options.doc:
How many quota locations the player must complete between each checkpoint unlock event.
With the default values (num_quotas=15 and quota_checkpoint_every=3), quota locations will be grouped into five
spheres with three locations each. This helps ensure that important early items are not stuck behind late quota
locations. Set higher than num_quotas to disable checkpoints entirely and group all quota locations into a single
sphere.
options.doc_fr:
Combien d'emplacements de quotas le joueur doit remplir entre chaque point de contrôle déverrouillage événement.
Avec les valeurs par défaut (num quotas=15 et quota checkpoint every=3), les emplacements des quotas seront regroupés en cinq sphères avec trois emplacements chacun. Cela permet de s'assurer que les articles initiaux importants ne sont pas bloqués derrière les emplacements des contingents tardifs. Définissez plus haut que num quotas pour désactiver entièrement les points de contrôle et regrouper tous les emplacements de quotas en une seule sphère.

options.name: Money Per Quota Location
options.doc:
The total amount of quota a player must obtain to complete each quota location
For example, if money per quota location is 500, you need to reach 500 total quota for each quota location

options.name: Scrapsanity
options.doc:
Enables scrapsanity, which adds locations for collecting each scrap for the first time.
Warning: adds >50 locations to the randomizer
options.doc_fr:
Permet la folie, qui ajoute des emplacements pour la collecte de chaque ferraille pour la première fois.
Warning: ajoute >50 emplacements au randomisateur

options.name: Randomize Company Building
options.doc:
Locks the company building behind an item in the multiworld, preventing the player from routing there to sell scrap until they receive 
the required item

options.name: Randomize Scanner
options.doc: Locks the scanner behind an item in the multiworld, rendering the player unable to scan until they receive it

options.name: Randomize Terminal
options.doc: Locks the terminal behind an item in the multiworld, preventing its use until the player receive the item

options.name: Starting Moon
options.doc:
This is the only moon the player will have access to at the start of a multiworld. All other moons are locked until 
received.
This can be set to any moon name, or 'randomize', which randomly selects a starting moon.

options.name: Starting Stamina Bars
options.doc: The player begins with this many stamina bars, and the rest have to be unlocked.

options.name: Starting Inventory Slots
options.doc: The player begins with this many inventory slots, and the rest have to be unlocked.

options.name: Grade Location Required Grade
options.doc:
The end-of-day grade required to complete a grade location on a moon. This option will be ignored if 
split_moon_grades is true.

options.name: Split Moon Grades
options.doc: Allows the player to customize the required grade for easy, medium, and hard moons separately.
options.doc_fr: Permet au joueur de personnaliser la note requise pour les lunes faciles, moyennes et durs séparément.

options.name: Easy Moon Location Grade
options.doc: The end-of-day grade required to complete a grade location on an easy difficulty moon

options.name: Medium Moon Location Grade
options.doc: The end-of-day grade required to complete a grade location on a medium difficulty moon

options.name: Hard Moon Location Grade
options.doc: The end-of-day grade required to complete a grade location on a hard difficulty moon

options.name: Minimum Scrap Spawn Chance
options.doc:
Scrap will not contain important items or be required for the Collectathon goal if their spawn chance on an in-logic 
moon is less than this percentage. A value of less than 3% can significantly slow down games, while values above 6% 
exclude most scrap.

options.name: Minimum Monster Spawn Chance
options.doc:
A bestiary entry will not contain important items if the monster's spawn chance on an in-logic moon is greater than or equal to this percentage. 
A value of less than 3% can significantly slow down games.
options.doc_fr:
Une entrée bestiaire ne contiendra pas d'éléments importants si les chances de frai du monstre sur une lune in-logicale sont supérieures ou égales à ce pourcentage.
Une valeur inférieure à 3% peut ralentir significativement les jeux.

options.name: Min Money Per Money Item
options.doc: The minimum amount of money that a money item can give the player.

options.name: Max Money Per Money Item
options.doc:
The maximum amount of money that a money item can give the player.
This can't be less than min_money.

options.name: Modify Scrap Spawns
options.doc:
Modifies the spawn rates and availability of scrap on every moon to reduce the chance of a player getting stuck for 
a long time trying to find a rare item that is blocking progression.

options.name: Exclude Killing
options.doc: Guarantees that scrapsanity locations requiring the player to kill an enemy will not contain important items
options.doc_fr: Garanties que les lieux de la folie qui obligent le joueur à tuer un ennemi ne contiennent pas d'éléments importants

options.name: Exclude Hive
options.doc: Guarantees that the Hive scrapsanity location will not contain an important item
options.doc_fr: Garanties que l'emplacement de la râpe de Hive ne contiendra pas d'élément important

options.name: Exclude Egg
options.doc: Guarantees that the Sapsucker Egg scrapsanity location will not contain an important item
options.doc_fr: Garanties que l'emplacement de ferraille d'oeufs Sapsucker ne contiendra pas d'élément important

options.name: Money Weight
options.doc:
The weight of money items in the filler/trap pool. 
When redeemed, this item grants between min_money and max_money credits, though they don't count toward the quota.

options.name: Birthday Gift Weight
options.doc:
The weight of birthday gifts in the filler/trap pool. 
When redeemed, this item sends a random store item down in the dropship.

options.name: Strength Training Weight
options.doc: The total weight of strength training items. Every item received reduces the carry weight of all scrap.

options.name: Scrap Cloning Weight
options.doc:
The weight of clone scrap items in the filler/trap pool. 
When redeemed, this item duplicates a random piece of scrap in the ship.

options.name: More Time Weight
options.doc:
The weight of more time items in the filler/trap pool. 
When redeemed, this item adds one day to the current quota (up to 9).

options.name: Less Time Weight
options.doc:
The weight of less time traps in the filler/trap pool. 
When consumed, this trap reduces the remaining time to complete the current quota by one day.

options.name: Bracken Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of bracken traps in the filler/trap pool.
When consumed, this trap spawns a bracken on the current or next moon visited.

options.name: Haunt Trap Weight
options.doc:
The weight of haunt traps in the filler/trap pool.
When consumed, this trap spawns a ghost girl on the current or next moon visited.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Death Link Scrap Loss
options.doc:
The percentage of scrap lost when the last living player dies from death link. 0 means no scrap is lost, 50 means 
half of the scrap in the ship is lost, 100 means all scrap is lost. This option does not preserve scrap if the last 
player dies naturally, and does nothing if death link is disabled.
